method.unit: participant_id/run_id/event_id; earliest event_menu_observed only; reobserved and click excluded from independent denominator
method.static_ids: not present; event_id is instance UUID; model_mapping is model inference, not server ID; note identities inferred from OCR consequence
method.outcomes: No server confirmation or note inventory vectors; coin/potential observations cannot establish note deduction or 12002 branch. No deduction-kernel fit or branch CI.

marginal_uniformity_tests.method: Two-sided exact binomial probability ordering; Holm across fourteen event/note comparisons. Exploratory event-level tests do not account for within-participant dependence. Unadjusted cluster bootstrap CIs are descriptive, not evidence of multiplicity-adjusted deviation.
marginal_uniformity_tests.global_interpretation: Retain the 21-pair multinomial Monte Carlo tests as the global tests; marginal tests cannot establish uniformity.
